name: How long does it take to see results from AEO efforts?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO efforts?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from AEO efforts can vary, but typically businesses start to see initial changes within 3 to 6 months. Factors such as the competitiveness of your industry, the quality and quantity of your optimized content, and the frequency of search engine algorithm updates influence this timeline. Gaining featured snippets or knowledge panel positions can sometimes happen faster for less competitive queries. However, sustained and impactful AEO success requires ongoing effort, monitoring, and adaptation, as search engines continually refine how they present direct answers. Expect AEO to be a long-term strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO results typically appear within 3-6 months, influenced by industry competition and content quality; sustained success requires ongoing effort.
